h: Seafront, Old Town and cliff railways
p: Pelham Place puts you right where Hastings' seafront meets the Old Town, so a spin here sits nicely alongside a proper wander. One thing to be clear on: Admiral is 18+, so while Playland under the same roof suits families, the slots side is adults only.

Walk east and you're on the Stade, with the tall black net huts, fishing boats hauled up on the shingle and fresh fish sold straight off the beach. The East Hill Cliff Railway climbs from there up to the country park, while the West Hill lift takes you up towards the castle ruins and St Clement's Caves. Head the other way and Hastings Pier stretches out from the front. Plenty to fill an afternoon either side of this one.
